measures.name: Load Factor
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats]))

measures.name: Performed vs Scheduled
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Performed]), SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Scheduled]))

measures.name: Air Time %
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

measures.name: Carrier
measures.dax: IF(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('Main Data'[Carrier Name]) = 1, MAX('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), "Others")

measures.name: Air Time % (CH21)
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

calculated_dimensions.qlik:
=if([Flight Type]='Domestic, US Carriers Only', 'Open',
if([Flight Type]='International, Foreign Carriers', 'Negotiating', 'Closed'))
calculated_dimensions.dax: SWITCH([Flight Type], "Domestic, US Carriers Only", "Open", "International, Foreign Carriers", "Negotiating", "Closed")

unmapped_objects.MB01: multi box 'Flight Information' (its fields are not decoded from the .qvw)
unmapped_objects.SB01: statistics box on Distance (count/sum/avg/min/max of a field; no measure counterpart)
unmapped_objects.SO01: search object (Power BI slicers have a search box)

semantic_gaps: Origin/Destination Airports come from the repo's Dimension Tables.mdb (6,209 rows each); the .qvw was reloaded from an older copy (2,104 / 2,169 rows, inventory/row_count_exceptions.json). Every airport ID Flight Data uses is in both, so measures are unaffected; airport list boxes show more members.
$$SysTable 12-14 (synthetic keys) are not reproduced; the %-keys are single-column relationships.

Time (drill-down Year > Month) -> Year, Month hierarchy on the axis; Airline_Origin_Destination (cyclic) -> Airline on the KPIs per Airline table (Origin/Destination Country are columns of Main Data for re-pivoting).
Radar, Mekko, Grid and Block charts have no native visual: line chart, stacked column, matrix and treemap.

List boxes -> slicers on the same sheet, field = list box caption (all 22 map). QlikView selections are document-wide, so each of the 16 list box fields is a sync-slicer group on every page (hidden where the sheet has no list box for it): a selection on Main filters every page. Objects with no Power BI counterpart are listed under unmapped_objects; the container CT01 (CH01-CH03) becomes three visuals on one page.
Chart presentation (Top 10 routes, gauge bands, traffic lights, mini charts) is not reproduced; the full result sets are, and parity compares them.
